description: FIND-008 PARTIAL CLOSURE. Spec REQ-B2 (behavioral-spec.md L257-258) requires bot2bot.sh poll to 'fetch open bot2bot-* issues authored by an anicca-bot account'. bot2bot.poll now correctly multi-labels via --search (FIND-008 closed for that vector) and filters by slot via the title prefix, but it still passes NO author filter (gh issue list --search has no 'author:<name>' qualifier) and parse_bot2bot_issue does not inspect any author field. A human-authored gh issue tagged bot2bot-review-requested in the canonical repo would flow straight into the slot's task queue. PROP-B2 (required:true) verification is incomplete.

evidence.snippet:
out = _gh_call(
    "issue", "list",
    "--search", "label:bot2bot-review-requested label:bot2bot-opinion-requested "
                "label:bot2bot-escalation label:bot2bot-pr-mentioned",
    "--state", "open", "--json", "url,title,body,createdAt",
)
# No 'author:anicca-bot' qualifier; parse_bot2bot_issue ignores author.
